verdict.rationale: The firm's Startup, Emerging & Growth Companies page lists "Exits, including IPOs, going private, and mergers & acquisitions" and describes guiding clients through to "successful and lucrative exits." Its llms.txt describes Venture M&A sell-side and buy-side counsel on acquisitions of venture-backed companies, covering earnouts, escrows and equity holder consents, and executive-compensation pages cover M&A Section 280G work. However, the IPO side is only a one-line service mention, and the evidence shows no dedicated M&A or IPO/capital-markets page with documented deal experience. Missing for 10: dedicated M&A and IPO practice pages, concrete exit deal examples or track record for venture-backed companies, substantive IPO/public-offering detail, independent corroboration.
